@graph.name: Is VOS a Pepperi alternative, and is it better than Pepperi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quite a different thing, and it is better to be blunt about that. Pepperi serves your sales organization: the rep, the van and the shelf. VOS deals only with how the order gets to you. At pulling a reorder from a kitchen that will never log in, we think VOS wins. At everything else on their product list the question does not really apply: we have no route accounting, no store audits, no CRM and no promotion engine, and none of it is planned.

@graph.name: Does Pepperi not already let customers order for themselves?

acceptedAnswer.text: It does, and anyone who tells you otherwise has not read their site. They offer a branded self-service portal with each buyer's own catalog and pricing. Every route into it still means working a screen: searching the catalog, scanning a barcode or uploading a file. The accounts that were not going to do that are the ones this suits.

@graph.name: Do we give up route accounting and van sales?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if you drop the tool that does them, and we are not asking you to. VOS has never planned a route, loaded a van or reconciled a day's selling, and it does not track a shipment either. If those are what you are shopping for, Pepperi is the right call and we will say so.

@graph.name: We are a smaller operation. Does that change the answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is most of the answer. Their own site describes their customers as medium and enterprise. Ours says we are built for small to mid-size distributors, and that enterprise pricing and enterprise complexity are not your problem. Both companies are telling you who they are for, and it is worth taking them at their word.

Pepperi publishes no price on its own site, and nor do we. Be aware that third-party directories carry figures for them, so check any number you are shown against their own site. What we will say is that the scope is narrower here: you are buying one step, not the system your field force lives in.

@graph.name: How fast could this be running?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most distributors this is running in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens get a first order in the same day. There is no integration project, which is why a Pepperi alternative often gets shortlisted by people with no intention of replacing anything.

@graph.name: What about accounts that will only ever telephone?

acceptedAnswer.text: They go on telephoning, and your desk handles those as always. Be clear on the limit, though: a call or a voicemail gets no order number out of VOS, no timestamp, and nothing moving against stock. Only what comes through the app does.

@graph.name: Where do the Pepperi details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sourced from pepperi.com as it stood on 10 October 2026: their product modules, the buyer portal, the offline apps and their own words about the market they sell to. No price or rollout time is published by them, so neither is guessed at here. Anything out of date since is our error, not theirs.
